The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (ifmgd->auth_data) {
    // Ongoing authentication attempt
}
```
Reason:
The condition checks if there is ongoing authentication data (`auth_data`). If the device is suspended while this authentication attempt is still in progress, `cfg80211` cannot abort it, leading to a race condition where the authentication attempt continues during suspension, potentially causing firmware errors.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
ieee80211_send_deauth_disassoc(sdata,
                               ifmgd->auth_data->bss->bssid,
                               IEEE80211_STYPE_DEAUTH,
                               WLAN_REASON_DEAUTH_LEAVING,
                               false, frame_buf);
ieee80211_destroy_auth_data(sdata, false);
```
Reason:
These statements explicitly send a deauthentication frame to abort the ongoing authentication attempt when the device is suspending. This ensures that the authentication process is properly terminated, preventing the race condition and associated firmware errors.

You will be given the root cause of a bug, the commit message and the corresponding patch.
        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The root cause of the bug is a race condition between the suspension of the device and ongoing authentication attempts. Since `cfg80211` does not track authentication attempts, it cannot abort them when the device is being suspended. This can lead to authentication attempts continuing to run during suspension, potentially causing errors in the firmware, particularly in the iwlmvm driver.
        
        Commit message:
        mac80211: fix suspend vs. authentication race

Since Stanislaw's patch removing the quiescing code, mac80211 had
a race regarding suspend vs. authentication: as cfg80211 doesn't
track authentication attempts, it can't abort them. Therefore the
attempts may be kept running while suspending, which can lead to
all kinds of issues, in at least some cases causing an error in
iwlmvm firmware.

Fix this by aborting the authentication attempt when suspending.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: 12e7f517029d ("mac80211: cleanup generic suspend/resume procedures")
Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>  
        
        Patch:
        diff --git a/net/mac80211/mlme.c b/net/mac80211/mlme.c
index 5ade21eb3602..6d24e6c8f320 100644
--- a/net/mac80211/mlme.c
+++ b/net/mac80211/mlme.c
@@ -3576,6 +3576,32 @@ static void ieee80211_restart_sta_timer(struct ieee80211_sub_if_data *sdata)
 }
 
 #ifdef CONFIG_PM
+void ieee80211_mgd_quiesce(struct ieee80211_sub_if_data *sdata)
+{
+	struct ieee80211_if_managed *ifmgd = &sdata->u.mgd;
+	u8 frame_buf[IEEE80211_DEAUTH_FRAME_LEN];
+
+	sdata_lock(sdata);
+
+	if (ifmgd->auth_data) {
+		/*
+		 * If we are trying to authenticate while suspending, cfg80211
+		 * won't know and won't actually abort those attempts, thus we
+		 * need to do that ourselves.
+		 */
+		ieee80211_send_deauth_disassoc(sdata,
+					       ifmgd->auth_data->bss->bssid,
+					       IEEE80211_STYPE_DEAUTH,
+					       WLAN_REASON_DEAUTH_LEAVING,
+					       false, frame_buf);
+		ieee80211_destroy_auth_data(sdata, false);
+		cfg80211_tx_mlme_mgmt(sdata->dev, frame_buf,
+				      IEEE80211_DEAUTH_FRAME_LEN);
+	}
+
+	sdata_unlock(sdata);
+}
+
 void ieee80211_sta_restart(struct ieee80211_sub_if_data *sdata)
 {
 	struct ieee80211_if_managed *ifmgd = &sdata->u.mgd;

        Root cause:
        The root cause of the bug is a race condition between the suspension of the device and ongoing authentication attempts. Since `cfg80211` does not track authentication attempts, it cannot abort them when the device is being suspended. This can lead to authentication attempts continuing to run during suspension, potentially causing errors in the firmware, particularly in the iwlmvm driver.
        
        Commit message:
        mac80211: fix suspend vs. authentication race

Since Stanislaw's patch removing the quiescing code, mac80211 had
a race regarding suspend vs. authentication: as cfg80211 doesn't
track authentication attempts, it can't abort them. Therefore the
attempts may be kept running while suspending, which can lead to
all kinds of issues, in at least some cases causing an error in
iwlmvm firmware.

Fix this by aborting the authentication attempt when suspending.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: 12e7f517029d ("mac80211: cleanup generic suspend/resume procedures")
Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>  
        
        Patch:
        diff --git a/net/mac80211/pm.c b/net/mac80211/pm.c
index af64fb8e8add..d478b880a0af 100644
--- a/net/mac80211/pm.c
+++ b/net/mac80211/pm.c
@@ -100,10 +100,18 @@ int __ieee80211_suspend(struct ieee80211_hw *hw, struct cfg80211_wowlan *wowlan)
 
 	/* remove all interfaces that were created in the driver */
 	list_for_each_entry(sdata, &local->interfaces, list) {
-		if (!ieee80211_sdata_running(sdata) ||
-		    sdata->vif.type == NL80211_IFTYPE_AP_VLAN ||
-		    sdata->vif.type == NL80211_IFTYPE_MONITOR)
+		if (!ieee80211_sdata_running(sdata))
 			continue;
+		switch (sdata->vif.type) {
+		case NL80211_IFTYPE_AP_VLAN:
+		case NL80211_IFTYPE_MONITOR:
+			continue;
+		case NL80211_IFTYPE_STATION:
+			ieee80211_mgd_quiesce(sdata);
+			break;
+		default:
+			break;
+		}
 
 		drv_remove_interface(local, sdata);
 	}
